collection.description: A villager is trusted with a friend's secret, and a group by the well asks them about it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (friend) has told (subject) a secret: (friend.he/she) is learning a song to sing at the next festival, all on (friend.his/her) own, in front of everyone. Nobody else knows. Today, by the well, a group of villagers are wondering aloud why (friend) keeps disappearing behind the huts in the evenings, and they turn to (subject). "You're friends. You must know."

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "No idea," says (subject). "Maybe (friend.he/she) is teaching the crabs to dance." The group laughs. One of them, (doubter), squints at (subject) suspiciously, but (subject) holds firm. At the festival, when (friend) stands up to sing, (doubter) catches (subject)'s eye and mouths "CRABS?" (subject) just shrugs, and listens.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "Speaking of disappearing," says (subject), "has anyone seen the size of the fish that got away from me yesterday?" The conversation is instantly about fish. The secret is safe. (subject) later tells (friend), who is impressed. "You'd be a terrible liar, but you're an excellent distracter."
